profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Eurofins Diatherix
profile.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer with professional experience in developing web and desktop applications. Proficient in problem solving and collaborating with on-site and remote teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed an LLM-powered natural language interface between users and a SQL Server database. Integration of the interface into internal applications serves as a potential means of replacing existing complex spreadsheets and accelerating sales-team client preparation.
• Redesigned the laboratory requisitioning web client from an ASP.NET Web Forms application to a Blazor Server application. These changes improve the web client's extensibility for new features that add value for customers.
• Instituted data processing pipelines to integrate reference laboratory orders and results with the Laboratory Information System. This contributed to the integration of new test offerings such as serology and microbiology from other laboratories under Eurofins.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Developed software systems to support laboratory data processing and test results reporting of COVID-19 pooled sample testing. These systems contributed to the successful completion of school and airport pooled testing contracts with HHS and the CDC.
•	Established a client-server interface for receiving test order messages and transmitting test result messages over RESTful endpoints. This interface facilitated connections with EHR vendors and direct clients.
•	Cooperated with the sales team and cybersecurity team to implement changes to the laboratory’s web client for requisitioning tests and viewing results. These modifications served to add new features for attracting clients and served to defend the website against exploitation.
•	Collaborated with personnel in Louisville, Kentucky, to implement and test modifications to the Laboratory Information System to handle opening a new satellite laboratory. These changes helped to make the system scalable for use in the new satellite site and in future satellite sites.
positions.insights: Statistics, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +9 skills

positions.title: Software Developer I
positions.description:
•	Created data processing applications to integrate new diagnostic testing platforms with the Laboratory Information System. These applications contributed to the transition of new panel offerings developed on new platforms from the R&D team to the Operations team.
•	Implemented new reporting applications to transmit laboratory data on pathogens like COVID-19 to state health departments. These applications ensured compliance with state guidelines on pathogen reporting and contributed to governmental tracking of infectious diseases.
•	Designed and deployed a new framework for handling error codes during laboratory processing of client submitted samples. This framework improved the modularity of error codes and improved the speed of client notification when an error for a sample is found. 
•	Modified existing systems to handle the sample volume increase from the COVID-19 pandemic.
positions.insights: Statistics, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +9 skills
